arxiv-2104-10145.title: Bulk superconductivity in FeTe 1-x Se x via physicochemical pumping of excess iron
arxiv-2104-10145.creator: Lianyang Dong, He Zhao, Ilija Zeljkovic, Stephen D. Wilson, John W. Harter
arxiv-2104-10145.description: Abstract The iron-based superconductor FeTe 1-x Se x has attracted considerable attention as a candidate topological superconductor owing to a unique combination of topological surface states and bulk high-temperature superconductivity. The superconducting properties of as-grown single crystals, however, are highly variable and synthesis dependent due to excess interstitial iron impurities incorporated during growth.

arxiv-2109-03027.title: Statistical analysis of locally parameterized shapes
arxiv-2109-03027.creator: Mohsen Taheri, and, Jörn Schulz
arxiv-2109-03027.description: Abstract The alignment of shapes has been a crucial step in statistical shape analysis, for example, in calculating mean shape, detecting locational differences between two shape populations, and classification. Procrustes alignment is the most commonly used method and state of the art. In this work, we uncover that alignment might seriously affect the statistical analysis.

arxiv-2302-02256.title: Almost-Sure Stability of the Single Mode Solution of a Noisy Autoparametric Vibration Absorber
arxiv-2302-02256.creator: Peter H. Baxendale, N. Sri Namachchivaya
arxiv-2302-02256.description: Abstract For a pendulum suspended below a vibrating block with white noise forcing, the solution in which the pendulum remains vertical is called the single mode solution. When this solution becomes unstable there is energy transfer from the block to the pendulum, helping to absorb the vibrations of the block.

arxiv-2307-06002.title: On off-critical zeros of lattice energies in the neighborhood of the Riemann zeta function
arxiv-2307-06002.creator: Laurent Bétermin, Ladislav Šamaj, Igor Travěnec
arxiv-2307-06002.description: Abstract The Riemann zeta function ζ ⁡ ( s ) := ∑ n = 1 ∞ 1 / n s \zeta(s):=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}1/n^{s} can be interpreted as the energy per point of the lattice ℤ \mathbb{Z} , interacting pairwisely via the Riesz potential 1 / r s 1/r^{s} .

arxiv-2309-01702.title: On Gevrey regularity of solutions for inhomogeneous nonlinear moment partial differential equations
arxiv-2309-01702.creator: Pascal Remy, Maria Suwińska
arxiv-2309-01702.description: Abstract . In this article we investigate Gevrey regularity of formal power series solutions for a certain class of nonlinear moment partial differential equations, the inhomogeneity of which is σ \sigma -Gevrey with respect to the time variable t t for a fixed σ ≥ 0 \sigma\geq 0 .

arxiv-2309-06394.title: Mass ratio of single-line spectroscopic binaries with visual orbits using Bayesian inference and suitable priors Journal: AJ Based in part on observations obtained at the Southern Astrophysical Research (SOAR) telescope, which is a joint project of the Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia, e Inovaçãoes
arxiv-2309-06394.creator: Jennifer Anguita-Aguero, Rene A. Mendez, Miguel Videla, Edgardo Costa, Leonardo Vanzi, Nicolas Castro-Morales, Camila Caballero-Valdes
arxiv-2309-06394.description: Abstract We present orbital elements for twenty-two single-line binaries, nine of them studied for the first time, determined from a joint spectroscopic and astrometric solution. The astrometry is based on interferometric measurements obtained with the HRCam Speckle camera on the SOAR 4.1m telescope at Cerro Pachon, Chile, supplemented with historical data.

arxiv-2510-21797.title: Quantifying Multimodal Imbalance: A GMM-Guided Adaptive Loss for Audio-Visual Learning
arxiv-2510-21797.creator: Zhaocheng Liu, Zhiwen Yu, Xiaoqing Liu
arxiv-2510-21797.description: Abstract The heterogeneity of multimodal data results in variations in data quality, where inconsistencies and imbalance can adversely influence the multimodal training process, allowing a dominant modality to dominate the gradient updates. Existing approaches to addressing Multimodal Imbalance can generally be categorized into optimization-based and data-based methods.

arxiv-2603-11425.title: Using the force landscape of an active solid to predict plastic deformation
arxiv-2603-11425.creator: Tyler Hain, Edan Lerner, M. Lisa Manning

pmc-10636955.title: Evaluation of parameters used in echocardiography and ultrasound protocol for the diagnosis of shock etiology in emergency setting
pmc-10636955.creator: Asmaa Ramadan, Tamer Abdallah, Hassan Abdelsalam, Ahmed Mokhtar, Assem Abdel Razek
pmc-10636955.description: BackgroundEarly recognition and appropriate treatment has shown to decrease morbidity and mortality in patients with undifferentiated shock. There are many ultrasound protocols in shock; each protocol combines core ultrasound elements such as IVC and cardiac assessment which includes detection of cardiac tamponade, left ventricular function and right ventricular strain.

pmc-10694627.title: Prior antibiotic administration disrupts anti-PD-1 responses in advanced gastric cancer by altering the gut microbiome and systemic immune response
pmc-10694627.creator: Chang Gon Kim, June-Young Koh, Su-Jin Shin, Ji-Hee Shin, Moonki Hong, Hyun Cheol Chung, Sun Young Rha, Hyo Song Kim, Choong-Kun Lee, Ji Hyun Lee, Yejeong Han, Hyoyong Kim, Xiumei Che, Un-Jung Yun, Hyunki Kim, Jee Hung Kim, Seo Young Lee, Su Kyoung Park, Sejung Park, Hyunwook Kim, Jin Young Ahn, Hei-
pmc-10694627.description: SummaryEvidence on whether prior antibiotic (pATB) administration modulates outcomes of programmed cell death protein-1 (PD-1) inhibitors in advanced gastric cancer (AGC) is scarce. In this study, we find that pATB administration is consistently associated with poor progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) in multiple cohorts consisting of patients with AGC treated with PD-1 inhibitors.

pmc-11678523.title: Treatment with Ascorbyl Glucoside–Arginine Complex Ameliorates Solar Lentigos
pmc-11678523.creator: Mariko Takada, Kayoko Numano, Masahiko Nakano, Akio Yamamoto, Genji Imokawa, Terrence Piva, Shosuke Ito
pmc-11678523.description: Little is known about the anti-pigmenting effects of skin-whitening agents on solar lentigos (SLs). To characterize the anti-pigmenting effects of a newly designed derivative ascorbyl glucoside–arginine complex (AGAC) on SLs, lotions with or without 28% AGAC were applied twice daily for 24 weeks in a double-blind half-face study of 27 Japanese females with SLs.

pmc-12504711.title: Synthesis of iron-modified montmorillonite/Al2O3 composite adsorbents and their phosphorus adsorption performance study
pmc-12504711.creator: Kexin Xie, Jiacheng Xie, Zhenxiang Zhao, Xiangwei Meng, Bo Chen
pmc-12504711.description: The presence of excessive phosphate in aquatic systems can trigger eutrophication processes, causing detrimental impacts on ecological balance. This research developed an innovative phosphorus-adsorbing composite material through iron-modified montmorillonite integrated with Al2O3, synthesized via surface modification coupled with hydrothermal calcination (Fe/AlPMt), for aquatic phosphorus management.

pmc-12612692.title: The value of consciousness: experiences worth having
pmc-12612692.creator: Léa Moncoucy, Krzysztof Dołęga, Catherine Tallon-Baudry, Axel Cleeremans
pmc-12612692.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Dennett (2020,personal communication) asked: ‘How do we go from doing things for reasons to having reasons for doing things?’. This question targets a fundamental shift in nature: while all organisms act in the way they do for reasons that are shaped by extrinsic evolutionary cost functions, some also act for reasons of their own, even engaging in behaviour that may be detrimental to their own existence. For such organisms, we argue, phenomenal experience—what it feels like—has intrinsic value.

pmc-12630245.title: MSC-Exosomes alleviate cognitive impairment after mild traumatic brain injury by inhibiting ferroptosis via PI3K/AKT/mTOR-mediated upregulation of GPX4
pmc-12630245.creator: Haoyang Hu, Mao Li, Yan Wang, Yang Liu, Hong Zhao, Dengfa Zhao, Pengyu Jiang, Xiaoxuan Yang, Xianyang Chen, Fei Yang
pmc-12630245.description: Mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) is a prevalent condition accounting for over 70% of all traumatic brain injury (TBI) cases, and it is a major cause of posttraumatic cognitive impairment. Ferroptosis, a form of regulated cell death characterized by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation, has been implicated in the pathophysiology of mTBI.

pmc-12744591.title: Acquisition and Transmission of tmexCD1-toprJ1-Positive Plasmids in Clinical ST17 Klebsiella pneumoniae
pmc-12744591.creator: Lijie Zheng, Jie Zhu, Feinan Qian, Qizhao Gao, Yicheng Wen, Hong Du
pmc-12744591.description: PurposeIt is well known that bacteria often acquire drug resistance genes through acquiring exogenous resistant plasmids. The tmexCD1-toprJ1-positive plasmid confers tigecycline resistance to bacterial strains.MethodsThree sequence type (ST) 17 Klebsiella pneumoniae strains were isolated from two patients within 5 days. Experimental and comparative genomic analyses were performed to investigate potential transmission routes and antimicrobial resistance phenotype disparities.

pmc-13130919.title: Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing After Subaortic Membrane Resection
pmc-13130919.creator: Eyad Alhaj, Layan Alhaj, Dema Alhaj, Ali Alhaj
pmc-13130919.description: BackgroundLeft bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) is an effective alternative to biventricular pacing for cardiac resynchronization therapy, particularly when coronary sinus anatomy is unfavorable.Case SummaryA 44-year-old man developed new-onset left bundle branch block and cardiomyopathy following surgical resection of a subaortic membrane. Left ventricular ejection fraction decreased to 30% despite optimal medical therapy.

pmc-13268528.title: Phenology of the elongate hemlock scale (Hemiptera: Diaspididae) on Fraser fir Christmas trees in western North Carolina
pmc-13268528.creator: Dominic Manz, Kelly L F Oten, Clyde E Sorenson, Justin G A Whitehill, Robert M Jetton
pmc-13268528.description: Understanding the seasonal phenology of an insect pest in a specific region on a specific host is fundamental to the timing of management actions. The elongate hemlock scale, Fiorinia externa Ferris (Hemiptera: Diaspididae), is an invasive insect from Japan known to infest various conifer hosts in its invasive range in eastern North America.

pmc-13390292.title: Aging under scarcity and insecurity: chronic disease, functional limitation, and basic need material insecurity among older adults in Haiti
pmc-13390292.creator: James Lachaud, Ruth Climat, Luckny Zephyr, Bogentson André, Marilisse Neptune Rouzier, Nixon Calixte
pmc-13390292.description: BackgroundOlder adults in low-income and fragile states often age with intersecting burdens of chronic disease, functional decline, and material deprivation, yet they remain largely invisible in research and policy. In Haiti, recurrent political crises, violence, and weak health and social protection systems may amplify late-life inequities, but national data are scarce.

pmc-13640250.title: Comparative plastome analyses of Lewinskya (Orthotrichaceae): insights into genome structure, molecular evolution, and phylogenetic relationships
pmc-13640250.creator: Wei Han, Kai Zhang, Yuanjin Zhao, Yuqing Li, Haifeng Luo, Zhixia Sun, Yin Li, Xihua Liu, Yu Jia
pmc-13640250.description: BackgroundMosses are key components of terrestrial ecosystems and provide important systems for studying plant diversity, adaptation, and genome evolution. Lewinskya is a species-rich moss genus in Orthotrichaceae, but species delimitation and phylogenetic reconstruction within the genus remain difficult because diagnostic characters are often subtle or convergent.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any person who shall, except as permitted by law, willfully resist, prevent, impede, or interfere with the Secretary or any of his agents in the performance of duties pursuant to this chapter shall be punished.
